build: pre-P0 master + mandelDump hook (tsc module:none concat build)
engine: V8 (Chrome 150), 20 cores; hashes are engine-family-specific (Math.* precision)
protocol: load url -> await mandelDump(): sharpening OFF, initial frame only; FNV-1a 32-bit over raw bytes; deField hashed with IN_SET entries masked to 0 (they hold stale scheduling-dependent side-channel values the app never reads)

windows.name: tierazon
windows.note: Cthulu Julia — transcendental compiled formula, 4:3 canvas. RE-BASELINED 2026-07-28 to be URL-faithful: the original capture used the tierazon() hook, whose spanY (YMAX−YMIN exactly) is NOT what a URL restore derives (span/aspect, last-ulps different; probed cap 6982 vs 6819). The hook state still reproduces the ORIGINAL hashes (verified on the P2 build: 451445512/9f8a38d0/a264c988). node* values: transcendental Math (sin/exp/log) differs between Chrome's and Node's V8 versions, so the Node runner gates against its own baseline (Node 22).
